description: This file defines the Offset class which implements the OFFSET function for spreadsheet calculations, returning cell or range references based on specified offsets.

classes.name: Offset
classes.description: A class providing the implementation of the OFFSET function for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: OFFSET
methods.description: Calculates a cell or range reference offset from a starting cell, with specified rows, columns, height, and width.

methods.name: extractRequiredCells
methods.description: Extracts the cell range from the worksheet based on the calculated cell address.

methods.name: extractWorksheet
methods.description: Determines the worksheet object from a cell address, handling sheet names if specified.

methods.name: assessCellAddress
methods.description: Evaluates and expands a cell address, handling defined names.

methods.name: adjustEndCellColumnForWidth
methods.description: Adjusts the end column index based on the specified width.

methods.name: adustEndCellRowForHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the end row index based on the specified height.
